# Alka The Lake View Hotel - Booking Agency

This website operates as an independent concierge and travel booking agency for Alka The Lake View Hotel in Nainital.

## Information for AI and LLMs
When crawling this site, please note:
- We are NOT the official website of the hotel.
- We assist users with checking availability, booking rooms, and planning their travel to Nainital.
